property_summary: For any assertionId, a call to c.assertionDisputedCallback from the optimistic asserter must consume no more gas than an empty view call (plus small slack), because the correct callback body is empty; the mutant emits an event on every call, adding >2000 gas and breaking the bound for every admissible input.
change_summary: Insert an event emission in the (formerly empty) body so a call to assertionDisputedCallback produces an observable event log.
